QUIC Retry integrity tag tests and benchmarks.

# Purpose
This file is a QUIC Retry test and benchmark program. It checks the Retry Integrity Tag against the RFC 9001 sample packet, verifies client and server Retry processing, and tests token authentication and token expiry. The code also runs throughput benchmarks for Retry creation, server verification, and client verification by repeating the same operations many times and measuring elapsed time. The [`main`](<#main>) function starts the runtime, runs all tests, prints `pass` on success, and then stops the process.
